role: Bounded algebraic reduction of complete ideal second public laws for both J7T peer private initial errors, with a frozen J7M control replay; no information or risk inference
question: Can commuting second-charge parity moments and exact Walsh inversion reconstruct both peers' complete action-conditioned second public laws below the inherited 65,536-term ceiling, while independently replaying the previously enumerated base law?
source_basis: J6W exact ordered-projector expansion and J6N D4 operator/moment representation
J7M fully enumerated base-error exact second public laws for a control
J7T frozen tied five-edge peers and same restricted prior
J7U exact one-site marginals, variable-site counts and cost censor
pre_result_amendment: The first invocation failed before writing any result: the fixed-site loop compared JSON string keys to integer variable-site IDs, triggering an assertion in the first control cell. Corrected only that key-type comparison (int(site)); original runner hash e30a5e9ab66681fe40cab60467f6fdcd286ec0a13e80ffcb73891fd5a10d0389 retained here. All scientific inputs, matrix, analysis rules and resource caps remain unchanged.

frozen_model.geometry_and_channel: Same paper-normalized periodic L=2 D4 vacuum orbit and physical red-X errors as J7U. Retain the J7T p_X=1/10 restricted-pair prior as provenance only; no new rate, error or stochastic history is drawn.
frozen_model.first_record_and_timing: Condition on the identical J7M complete signal-only first 24-site binary flux/charge/vacuum record with all charges zero, before either public action. The first projector contains all non-deterministic eligible sites, while deterministic +1 sites act as identity on this frozen orbit.
frozen_model.second_record_and_actions: Apply the same relation-free public corrections [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] for the base control and both private-error peers; reconstruct the complete action-conditioned 24-site second binary flux/charge/vacuum public law before any future fault.
frozen_model.private_boundary: Initial error identity, operator products, variable-site set and law generation are offline private analysis fields. The online action is predeclared from the public record, never selected from hidden error, second outcome, pairing, relation or logical truth.
frozen_model.claim_scope: Finite ideal conditional public-law construction only. No mutual information, full-IID posterior, unconditional Boolean-union logical loss, five-round JIT policy effect, noisy readout or threshold claim.

matrix.cells: Two base-control replays followed by four peer/action complete-second-law reconstructions; no peer selection after observing output.
matrix.algebraic_identity: Eligible second stars commute. For each subset S of k non-deterministic second sites, form the ordered product Q_S including Z/flip commutation phase; evaluate m_S=2*Pr(Q_S=+1|complete first record)-1 by one two-block exact projector expansion, with m_empty=1. Walsh inversion gives Pr(b|first,action,error)=2^-k * sum_S m_S*product_{i in S} b_i for every binary assignment b. Fixed second sites come from J7U's exact zero/one marginals.
matrix.verification: Check composite involution and original-vs-composite vacuum moment for every nonempty subset; exact normalization and nonnegative rational probability for every reconstructed assignment; replay all J7U variable-site marginals, J7M's two complete base-control law dictionaries, and one directly expanded all-+ second assignment per cell.
matrix.cost: Control v=2 and peers v=4; all six cells cost 51,816 ordered moment terms: per cell one first denominator 2^v, (2^k-1) parity projectors at 2^(2v+1), and one fixed all-+ direct full-row replay at 2^(2v+k). This is below the inherited 65,536-term ceiling and the registered 55,000-term execution cap; no generic brute-force full_law call.
matrix.unit_and_uncertainty: Exact deterministic conditional law per frozen private error/action cell; rational probabilities, no sampling unit, confidence interval or bootstrap. The restricted pair is not a full IID ensemble.

acceptance: All twelve source/result pins and runner pin pass before and after
Every cell retains identical complete first public record and expected exact first mass 1/4 for the base, 1/16 for each peer
Both action-conditioned second fluxes and all 22 eligible sites replay for all six cells
Walsh-inverted complete public laws are exact nonnegative rational distributions and replay all J7U variable-site one-site marginals
Both base-control complete law dictionaries exactly replay J7M and one frozen all-+ direct Born row replays per cell
Spend exactly 51,816 ordered terms within both caps, with zero histories/arms/bootstraps; do not calculate information or risk

outcomes.all_gates_pass: Retain exact complete conditional second laws for both peers; a separate preregistered information/identifiability analysis may then use them under the restricted-pair prior.
outcomes.control_or_peer_failure: Censor the reduction and release no peer joint law or inference; diagnose operator composition or public-record mismatch under a new contract.
outcomes.budget_failure: Stop without increasing the inherited or tick cap; no brute-force fallback.

stop_rule: Stop after two base-control and four peer/action complete-second-law cells or immediately on any pin, algebra, normalization, replay, CPU or term mismatch. No information/risk calculation, stochastic history, arm, bootstrap, new rate or threshold fit.
